description: The firm's governing instruments — policies, standards, procedures, runbooks and charters — with owner, type, status, approval record and review cadence. Core component 4 of the GRC framework (policy management): policies existed and were discoverable, but nothing recorded which of them had actually been approved, by whom, or when they are next due. The human view is docs/governance/policy-register.md.
review_cadence: Annually, and whenever an instrument is added, approved or retired.

status_meanings.in-force: Operative today. Either formally approved (approval recorded below) or an operational instrument that takes effect on publication.
status_meanings.draft: Written and ready, NOT operative — awaiting an approval act by a named body.
status_meanings.pending-adoption: Operative in practice but not yet formally adopted by the body that must adopt it.

instruments.title: AI Policy
instruments.note: Ratified 2026-07-02 (§9). The top-level instrument; everything below either implements it or is scoped by it.

instruments.title: AI Acceptable Use Policy
instruments.approval_note: Operative on publication (2026-06-21) and enforced in-product by the acknowledgment gate before the Advisor answers; no separate approval act was required.
instruments.note: The only instrument with a technical enforcement point in the app: acknowledgment is a precondition of use.

instruments.title: Risk Appetite Statement 2026
instruments.approval_note: Awaiting board resolution R7 (open-actions item 17). It describes the appetite the estate already enforces; CI fails if the two diverge.
instruments.note: Next review starts from ratification, so no date is asserted while the instrument is draft.

instruments.title: AI Governance Committee Charter
instruments.approval_note: Charters nothing until the Section 8 adoption block is signed at a board sitting (open-actions item 4).
instruments.note: Prepared 2026-07-16 so that the chartering act is a signature rather than a drafting exercise.

instruments.title: Operating Model (squad shape, RACI, MLRO delegation matrix)
instruments.approval_note: Reviewed at the management review rather than by a separate approval act.
instruments.note: Defines what the accountable owner may delegate — the authority basis every procedure below relies on.

instruments.title: Data Retention Standard
instruments.note: Implements the record-keeping obligation OB-08; the purge path is tested in CI.

instruments.title: TFS Name-Match Procedure (PNMR / CNMR / FFR)
instruments.approval_note: Operative on publication (2026-07-28); annual review and tabletop are calendared.
instruments.note: Discharges OB-04/OB-05: suspend without delay, verify, report, release only on a written basis.

instruments.title: Red-Team Procedure (prompt injection)
instruments.approval_note: Operative on publication; the automated half runs every CI build, the manual campaign quarterly.
instruments.note: First manual campaign round is open-actions item 15.

instruments.title: Curated Sanctions List Update SOP (EOCN)
instruments.note: The human path by which a curated list changes — the one screening input not fetched automatically.

instruments.title: AI Incident Runbook
instruments.note: Triggers, kill switch, response steps; the AI Act Art. 73-equivalent clocks live in the EU AI Act assessment.

instruments.title: Backup, Recovery & Export Integrity Runbook
instruments.note: Owner header added 2026-07-28 — the instrument had no declared owner until this register asked for one.

instruments.title: App Setup Runbook (Day 0)
instruments.note: Owner header added 2026-07-28 for the same reason as POL-11.

instruments.title: Git History Scrub Runbook
instruments.approval_note: Operative on publication; a one-off remediation procedure rather than a recurring control.
instruments.note: Execution is open-actions item 1 and needs force-push temporarily enabled on main.

excluded.reason: This register's own human view. It records instruments; it is not one, and registering it would make the sweep circular.
Maps the UAE AI Charter's twelve principles to this estate. An external framework mapping, not an instrument the firm issues.
A descriptive statement of how outputs are interpretable and where the limits are. Documentation, not a governing instrument.
ISO/IEC 42001 Annex A applicability record. An assessment artefact, not an instrument the firm issues.

shadow_policy_note: No governing instrument exists outside this register. test/policies.test.mjs scans docs/ for filenames carrying policy, procedure, charter, runbook or sop and fails if one is neither registered nor explicitly excluded with a reason — so a procedure cannot be written, relied on, and left unowned and unreviewed.
